I got in touch with Sheng Li the developer. Updated to the latest version of eDMR and it solved the problem i had
The latest one is Version: 0.6.4.1
check: https://github.com/ShengLi/edmr
# install from github
library(devtools)
install_github("edmr", username = "ShengLi",build_vignettes=FALSE)
